name: Emergency guidance (red flag)

en.body: If this is an emergency, call 911 now or go to the nearest emergency room. A health worker has been told and will contact you. Clinic: {clinic_phone}.

fil.body: Kung ito ay emergency, tumawag agad sa 911 o pumunta sa pinakamalapit na emergency room. Naabisuhan na ang isang health worker at kokontakin ka niya. Klinika: {clinic_phone}.

review_note: Pending clinical review and native Filipino speaker review. Not yet approved for real patients.
